caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with visible bubbles, topped with tender chashu pork and crisp menma arranged in a neat mound. Served in a patterned bowl with a white spoon, it rests on a warm wooden table under soft, natural light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle scratches.
Chashu pork slice displays layered marbling, pinkish-white meat, and slightly glistening surface with visible fat striations.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, thick, and bubbly, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with curled, fibrous texture and irregular, segmented shapes.
The bowl is ceramic, white with a black geometric patterned rim and a gold-trimmed inner edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl, featuring a slender handle.
